description: Synthetic sesslint.cli.verify configure declarations from pinned src/sesslint/cli/verify.py (no checkout import). Run vectors omitted where sesslint.api.verify is unavailable in isolated exec.
known_parity_gaps: GAP-cli-verify-api-verify: When either source or repaired path is missing, Python `parser.error` prints a usage banner then `sesslint verify: error: sesslint verify requires both source and repaired session paths.` and exits 2; Rust `run` writes only that error line (the CPython usage banner is not reproduced) and returns 2. When both paths are set, Python `run` reaches `from sesslint import api` and would call `api.verify`; Rust `run` stops with Display `sesslint.api.verify is not available` (no import, no emit_text, no seal, no exit 0 or 1). The usage banner and import seam are gaps, not covered rows.
